subject: [PATCH v9 12/32] mm: split PMD swap entries into PTE swap entries

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch splits PMD swap entries into PTE swap entries in the Linux kernel's memory management (mm) module. The goal is to ensure that when a PMD can hold a swap entry, it can also be split by various operations such as mprotect(), munmap(), or MADV_FREE. This change allows for more efficient handling of swap entries and prevents potential issues with pmdp_invalidate() and pmd_page(). The patch modifies the __split_huge_pmd_locked() function in huge_memory.c to handle PMD swap entries correctly, including updating the PTEs and removing any unnecessary reference counting.
